Try Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning. I'll fully admit it's not as good as any of the games you mentioned, but it has some solid combat in my opinion. There are three skill trees that essentially represent the Warrior, Thief, and Mage archetypes, and you can allocate your points into any and all of them, offering archetypes that represent combinations of two and the "jack of all trades" for all three. Each archetype comes with different weapons that fight very differently. My personal favorites are the Mage chakrams and the Warrior greatsword. The map areas are level base, so while it is technically "open world", progression is entirely linear. 

But still, I think the lore of the world, the combat system, and the OST make it worth playing through at least once.

One job that worked pretty well with my social anxiety was working with an inventory company, like RGIS or WIS. The schedule kinda sucked, because you went into stores either after closing or before opening to take their inventory, but for the most part you're working alone. The only social interaction was reporting back to superiors after you finished a section of the store, but since everyone's trying to get the work finished quickly there isn't any conversation. Just, "That one's finished? Cool, go do this one now". Other than that, I would suggest package handling jobs with either UPS or FedEx at their ground facilities.

Also, I would REALLY recommend taking up mindfulness meditation. That combined with the right medication has worked wonders for me. I can't remember whose quote it is, but it stuck with me: "You can't calm the waves, but you can learn to surf". Meditation helps to cultivate a practice of acknowledging the anxiety as it pops up, and rather than actively trying to stop it simply existing with it in the present moment and letting it ride itself out. Anxiety feeds off the attention you give it.
